title: Create Forever Worlds
description: a modpack for a forever world with create mod, will be updated to newer versions when create does
body:
Create Forever world is a create focused modpack with alot of addons, the modpack will be updated to newer minecraft versions once create and the ddons also do, mods may change but i will try to not change alot for compatibility and so you dont loose stuff. The pack is very optimized (like 20 optimization mods).

Features

* farmers's delight 
* create and addons
* sodium, lithium, vanillin, noisium, saturn and loads more optimization
* vannilabackport so you already have the newest features
* shaders (optional)


if create updates to a newer minecraft version i would recommend checking the changelogs of the modpack first so u know what will be lost (if anything gets removed) and so u can prepare
